research_question: On the prospectively acquired V4 confirmation corpus, does the frozen 56D current-time Team Context Candidate change future bomb macro-zone forecasting performance relative to the frozen 24D Control?

corpus.selection: The first 20 technically eligible candidates in frozen candidate_rank order.

probability_validation.class_order: Use the exact 15-class order recorded in prediction.class_order.
probability_validation.valid_values: Every probability must be finite and greater than or equal to zero.
probability_validation.row_sum: Each probability row must sum to 1 within absolute tolerance 1e-6 and relative tolerance 0.
probability_validation.true_class_probability: Require strictly positive true-class probability before computing Log Loss. If this check fails, stop for implementation review; do not silently clip probabilities or remove the row.
probability_validation.zero_probability_policy: Zero probability for a non-true class is allowed. Zero true-class probability is not silently replaced with epsilon.
probability_validation.class_index_validation: Every target class index must be an integer in the inclusive range 0 through 14.
probability_validation.top1_prediction: Choose the index of the maximum probability. On an exact tie, choose the lowest class index.
probability_validation.top2_prediction: Sort probabilities descending with stable class-order tie handling. Select the first two class indices.
probability_validation.invalid_prediction_policy: Stop and document the issue without excluding a match or changing frozen feature semantics.

primary_evaluation.aggregation: Arithmetic mean of per-row negative log probability assigned to the true class.
primary_evaluation.difference: Candidate pooled Log Loss minus Control pooled Log Loss.
primary_evaluation.interpretation: Negative difference denotes lower Candidate Log Loss; positive difference denotes lower Control Log Loss.

numerical_definition.per_row_log_loss: Negative natural logarithm of the predicted probability assigned to the true class.
numerical_definition.calculation_dtype: Convert validated model probabilities to float64 before calculating the natural logarithm.
numerical_definition.pooled_model_log_loss: Arithmetic mean of per-row Log Loss across all eligible rows in the selected corpus, calculated separately for +5s and +10s.
numerical_definition.paired_difference: For each eligible row, Candidate Log Loss minus Control Log Loss. Primary comparison is the arithmetic mean of those paired differences.
numerical_definition.row_inclusion: Use all eligible target rows from all 20 selected matches. Do not balance or subsample matches or target classes.
numerical_definition.horizon_policy: Calculate and report +5s and +10s separately. Neither horizon may be selected or omitted based on observed results.

secondary_evaluation.brier_definition: Mean across eligible rows of the sum across 15 classes of (predicted_probability - one_hot_true_label)^2.
secondary_evaluation.equal_match_log_loss: Calculate mean Log Loss within each match, then take the unweighted mean across the 20 matches.

numerical_rules.multiclass_brier: For each row, sum the squared differences between the 15 predicted probabilities and the 15-dimensional one-hot target vector. Report the arithmetic mean over eligible rows. Do not divide the per-row sum by 15.
numerical_rules.accuracy: Fraction of eligible rows where the deterministic Top-1 prediction equals the true class index.
numerical_rules.macro_f1: Compute F1 for each of the 15 frozen classes using the full class index set 0 through 14, then take the unweighted mean. Use zero_division=0 when precision or recall is undefined.
numerical_rules.top2_accuracy: Fraction of eligible rows whose true class index is among the two highest-probability classes under the stable tie rule.
numerical_rules.equal_match_log_loss: For each match, calculate its mean per-row Log Loss. Then take the unweighted mean across all 20 selected matches.
numerical_rules.per_zone_support: For each of the 15 frozen target classes, count eligible rows whose true class equals that class.
numerical_rules.per_zone_recall: For each target class with positive support, divide correctly predicted rows of that class by its support. If support is zero, report null rather than inventing a value.
numerical_rules.top1_confidence: Maximum predicted class probability for each eligible row.
numerical_rules.top1_confidence_ece: Use 10 fixed confidence bins with edges 0.0, 0.1, ..., 1.0. Bins 0 through 8 are left-inclusive and right-exclusive; the final bin includes 1.0. Within each nonempty bin, calculate mean Top-1 confidence and observed Top-1 accuracy. ECE is the sum across nonempty bins of (bin row count / total eligible rows) times the absolute difference between bin accuracy and mean confidence. An empty bin contributes zero.
numerical_rules.reporting: Calculate every secondary metric separately for each model and each prediction horizon.

uncertainty.quantity: Candidate minus Control pooled multiclass Log Loss.
uncertainty.resampling: Sample 20 match identities with replacement per replicate. Include every eligible row of each sampled match. A repeated match contributes its rows repeatedly.
uncertainty.aggregation: For each replicate, sum the paired per-row Log Loss differences across sampled matches and divide by the total number of sampled rows.

primary_bootstrap.sampling: Sample 20 match identities with replacement from the 20 selected matches. Use the same sampled identities for Candidate and Control.
primary_bootstrap.repeated_match_policy: If a match is sampled multiple times, include all of its eligible rows once for each occurrence.
primary_bootstrap.replicate_statistic: Sum the paired per-row Log Loss differences across the sampled matches, counting repetitions, and divide by the corresponding total number of sampled eligible rows.
primary_bootstrap.interval: The 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles of the 20000 replicate statistics.
primary_bootstrap.horizon_policy: Generate and report Bootstrap results separately for +5s and +10s.
primary_bootstrap.deterministic_match_order: Order matches by frozen candidate_rank before generating Bootstrap indices.
primary_bootstrap.rng_policy: Initialize a NumPy default_rng with seed 20260919 separately for each horizon. Use integers(0, 20, size=(20000, 20)) to generate match indices.

supporting_equal_match_bootstrap.estimand: Equal-match mean Candidate-minus-Control Log Loss difference.
supporting_equal_match_bootstrap.role: Supporting analysis, not a replacement for the primary pooled comparison.
supporting_equal_match_bootstrap.per_match_statistic: Within each match and horizon, calculate the arithmetic mean of Candidate-minus-Control per-row Log Loss differences.
supporting_equal_match_bootstrap.observed_statistic: Arithmetic mean of the 20 per-match difference values, assigning equal weight to each match.
supporting_equal_match_bootstrap.replicate_statistic: Sample 20 match identities with replacement and calculate the arithmetic mean of their per-match difference values, counting repetitions.
supporting_equal_match_bootstrap.interval: The 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles of the 20000 replicate statistics.
supporting_equal_match_bootstrap.deterministic_match_order: Order matches by frozen candidate_rank before generating Bootstrap indices.
supporting_equal_match_bootstrap.rng_policy: For each horizon, reuse the same sampled match-index matrix as the primary pooled Bootstrap. Calculate a different statistic from those same sampled matches.
supporting_equal_match_bootstrap.comparability: This supporting statistic follows the equal-match aggregation used in the frozen V4 Development evaluation.

execution_boundary.unexpected_implementation_failure: Stop and document the failure. Do not change the frozen manifest, target semantics, feature definitions, model artifacts, or scoring rules in response to results.

revision_policy: This scoring protocol is frozen before the first V4 confirmation model prediction or metric calculation. Do not modify it in place. Any necessary change requires an explicit, versioned and committed amendment before the affected scoring activity. Confirmation results must not be used for model refitting, feature selection, candidate replacement or posthoc metric selection.
